capture_run.window: 2024-09-01/2026-08-20 (plus dated older records, flagged as old)
capture_run.spec: External Feedback Capture — one record per distinct piece of feedback; no merging, no dedup
capture_run.verbatim_policy: One short verbatim excerpt per retrieved source document. Additional records drawn from the same document carry normalized statements with verbatim null. This is a reproduction constraint, not an evidence gap — the underlying items were read.
capture_run.collection_tier: C — open-web retrieval, not platform API scraping
